events.name: Frost Fest Winter Carnival
events.description: A three-day winter carnival in Gyro Park with outdoor fun, live entertainment, family activities and hot chocolate. Highlights include the Peach City Rail Jam, the Frost Fest Face-Off, the Frost Fest Gala and the Frosty Toes Winter Dip. The full schedule is posted at frostfest.ca.

events.name: Air Supply: A Matter of Time Canadian Tour w/ Glass Tiger at the South Okanagan Events Centre
events.description: Pop duo Air Supply — Graham Russell and Russell Hitchcock — celebrate 50 years together on the A Matter of Time tour, pairing hits like “Lost in Love” and “All Out of Love” with songs from their first studio album in 15 years. Glass Tiger joins the bill. Tickets start at $65 plus fees, online at ValleyFirstTix.com or at the SOEC box office.

events.name: Theory of a Deadman “The Northern Chaos Tour” at the Penticton Trade and Convention Centre
events.description: Canadian rock band Theory of a Deadman brings The Northern Chaos Tour, mixing favourites like “Bad Girlfriend” and “Not Meant to Be” with songs from their new EP, Part 1: Funeral Songs. Special guest Mammoth, Wolfgang Van Halen's hard rock project, joins the bill. Tickets start at $85 plus fees at ValleyFirstTix.com or the SOEC box office.

events.name: Okanagan Fest of Ale 2027
events.description: The Okanagan Fest of Ale returns to the Penticton Trade and Convention Centre for two days of beer tasting. Tickets include two tasting tokens, a tasting glass and live entertainment, with food options and indoor and outdoor games; extra tokens are sold on site. It's 19+ with no in/out privileges, and tickets aren't on sale yet.

events.name: A Night Under OneSky Legacy Gala Presented by Penticton Honda
events.description: OneSky Community Resources marks 60 years with a legacy gala, presented by Penticton Honda, that brings together community leaders, partners and supporters for an evening of celebration in support of the OneSky Community Resources Legacy Foundation. Tickets are $165–$175.

events.name: Ogopogo Extreme Triathlon
events.description: One of the world's toughest triathlons: a 3.8 km pre-dawn swim in Skaha Lake, a 183 km bike with 3,100 m of climbing to Apex Mountain, then a run over two mountain summits, finishing on the trails of Nickel Plate Park. Registration is $500.

events.name: Roseanarig Live
events.description: Roseanarig — the duo of Annarose Thomson and Paolo Rigoni — play speakeasy-style jazz, blues and vintage covers in the Broken Hearts Club at Crown & Thieves. Expect velvety vocals, grooves and dancing, with cocktails and wine for purchase. Doors open an hour before the show, and seating is preassigned. Tickets are $15.

events.name: Ella's Naughty Drag Brunch
events.description: Ella Lamoureux and a rotating cast of drag performers host a brunch full of sass, outrageous humour and show-stopping numbers at the Unicorn Lounge. Bring your crew and reserve your spot. Admission is $10.

events.name: Deep Rest: Yoga Nidra in the Himalayan Salt Cave
events.description: A restorative evening in Room and Pillar Spa's Himalayan salt cave with Aleena McKinnon of Buddha Beats Yoga. After a few gentle stretches, you're guided into a long Yoga Nidra (yogic sleep) session, a deeply meditative state that helps calm the nervous system and release tension. Minimal movement is involved. Cost is $55.

events.name: Smokies & S'mores
events.description: A fall farm outing at Meadow Vista Honey Wines: roast s'mores at the fire pits, tuck into a local honey smokie lunch or dinner, visit the bees and sip mulled wine or hot chocolate by the fire. There's also an exclusive fall scavenger hunt with prizes and a Fall Draw to enter. Tickets are $25–39.

events.name: A Freida Whales Drag Show
events.description: Freida Whales hosts an intimate drag show in The Broken Hearts Club speakeasy at Crown & Thieves. Cocktails, wine, beer, cider and non-alcoholic drinks are for sale. Seating is pre-assigned, so add the names of friends who bought separately when ordering. It's a 19+ event; tickets are $40.

events.name: Coverboy
events.description: Coverboy — the Proper Man lads and their friend Calvin — play cover songs with a twist in the Broken Hearts Club speakeasy at Crown & Thieves, from rock classics to newer hits. Cocktails and wine are for purchase. Doors open an hour before the show, seating is preassigned, and expect a lively dance floor. Tickets are $35.

events.name: Drag Brunch with Joan & Janice
events.description: A Sunday drag brunch at Unicorn Lounge starring Joan & Janice Everyday, an intergalactic duo of alien queens whose seemingly chaotic act is a carefully planned performance full of artistry and laughs. Bring your crew and reserve your spot ahead. Admission is $10.

events.name: Little Shop of Horrors
events.description: Actors Studio stages the cult-classic musical by Howard Ashman and Alan Menken as a dinner-theatre night. Down-on-his-luck florist Seymour discovers a plant with a taste for flesh, and as Audrey II grows, so does the trouble. Expect rock, Motown and dark comedy with plenty of camp. Tickets are $82.

events.name: Mario Kart Tournament
events.description: Race for prizes at Red Bird Brewing's free Mario Kart tournament, played on a big screen. Sign up on the tournament form, and if you come with a friend, pick different brackets so you don't knock each other out. One winner spins the prize wheel at the end. Arrive at the start time to order food and drinks and check in.

events.name: Okanagan in Colour: Two Artists, One Valley
events.description: Artists Danielle Harshenin and Leanne Spanza bring two distinct perspectives to a vibrant exhibition of Okanagan landscapes, light and colour — shimmering lakes, rolling hills, vineyards, orchards and the mountains that frame the valley. Admission to the Peachland Art Gallery is free.

events.name: Ocean Within: Yin Yoga, Ocean Drums in the Salt Cave
events.description: A restorative Yin yoga class inside Room and Pillar's Himalayan salt cave, led by Aleena McKinnon of Buddha Beats Yoga with ocean drums. The practice is designed to calm the nervous system, release deep tension and bring you back into balance. $55 per class.

events.name: Fall 36th Annual Great Okanagan Book Sale
events.description: Book lovers from around the Okanagan and beyond are invited to the fall edition of the Great Okanagan Book Sale, hosted by Kelowna Friends of the Library. It's a fundraiser for the Okanagan Regional Library, and admission is free. Hours vary by day, with the last day closing early in the afternoon.

events.name: Android for Beginners
events.description: A free beginner workshop at the Kelowna library for getting comfortable with Android devices. Topics include using the touch screen, adjusting device settings and managing apps — a relaxed way to build confidence with your phone or tablet.

events.name: Neighbourhood Pulse Pop-Up: Bark Party
events.description: A free Neighbourhood Pulse pop-up in the park turns into a Bark Party for dog lovers, with play zones, treats and entertainment. Dress your pooch in a costume for the dog parade and costume contest. These pop-ups are casual community hangouts meant for meeting neighbours and making new connections.

events.name: October Open Mic and Open Slam
events.description: IWC hosts an evening of poetry, prose and music at Hello Darlin', with six open mic spots and six open slam spots. Bring your stories, poems and songs — spots are first come, first served. Admission is $6–10.

events.name: Okanagan International Film Festival and Forum Opening Night
events.description: The Okanagan International Film Festival kicks off with an evening of film, community and conversation. Things begin at the Metro Hub with a welcome drink, an Okanagan Festival Blessing and a performance of the Okanagan Song by Anona Fawn Kampe and a special guest, plus festival announcements, prizes and time to mingle. Tickets are $30.

events.name: Steph Tolev Live
events.description: Stand-up from comedian and actor Steph Tolev, who has headlined across the country on her Filth Queen and Keepin' 'Em Hard tours and is a regular at LA's Comedy Store. Tickets range from about $39 to $131.

events.name: 80s Night: Headbangers Edition
events.description: Monsters of Mayhem recreate the sound, look and energy of '80s arena rock and heavy metal at Revelry, with songs from Judas Priest, Mötley Crüe, Van Halen, Ozzy Osbourne, Twisted Sister, KISS and more. General admission and VIP tables are available.

events.name: Candlelight: Featuring Vivaldi's Four Seasons & More
events.description: A string quartet plays Vivaldi's Four Seasons and La Follia by candlelight at The Laurel Packinghouse. The concert runs about 60 minutes; doors open 30 minutes early and there's no entry once it starts. Recommended for ages 8+, and under-16s must be with an adult. Tickets are $50–76 plus taxes.

events.name: Candlelight: Tribute to ABBA
events.description: A string quartet plays ABBA favourites by candlelight at The Laurel Packinghouse — Dancing Queen, SOS, Waterloo, Mamma Mia and more. The concert runs about 60 minutes; doors open 30 minutes early and there's no entry once it starts. Recommended for ages 8+, and under-16s must be with an adult. Seating is first come, first served within each zone. Tickets are $50–76 plus taxes.

events.name: Creatures of the Night Aerial Acrobatics Live
events.description: Performers from Vale Aerial Arts show off their skills on silks, hoop, hammock and pole in spooky, silly and dramatic routines at this third annual fundraiser. Proceeds support BEEPS and its bat conservation and education programs based in Peachland. Tickets are $35–45.

events.name: Live Music with James Hay
events.description: An easygoing evening of live music with James Hay at the Canyon Bar & Grill, paired with the restaurant's signature roast features and views over Gallagher's Canyon. Reservations are recommended to secure a table.

events.name: Okanagan International Film: Day 1
events.description: The first full day of the Okanagan International Film Festival, which celebrates Canadian, international and Indigenous cinema. The afternoon block includes Marigold: The Tale of God's Flower, Promises, Home Base, Gone, One Step and A Girl Called Alice, followed by an evening block with Reach for the Stars, Showtime and INVISIBLES. Tickets are $15.

events.name: The Return of Simon & Garfunkel
events.description: Simon & Garfunkel – A Musical Celebration brings the duo's songbook to the stage, with huge projected photos and original footage alongside live performances of hits like Mrs. Robinson, Cecilia, Bridge Over Troubled Water and Homeward Bound. Tickets are $49.95.

events.name: Bored Teachers: "Is it Friday Yet?" Comedy Tour
events.description: Bored Teachers bring their teacher-comedy show back to the stage with brand-new material. The comedians behind one of the most-followed teacher humour brands online, with a billion-plus views and a popular podcast, riff on grading, staff meetings and classroom life. Tickets range from about $55 to $106.

events.name: Busch Trio with Chamber Music Kelowna
events.description: Chamber Music Kelowna presents the Busch Trio, a piano trio that performs on gut strings, with violinist Mathieu van Bellen playing the historic "ex-Adolf Busch" Guadagnini violin. Known for their recordings of Dvořák, Schubert, Ravel and Shostakovich, they appear at leading festivals and concert halls across Europe and North America. Tickets are $67.50, or $25 for students with ID.

events.name: Dress for Success Watch Her Soar Gala 2026
events.description: A formal gala in support of Dress for Success Okanagan, which helps women build confidence and careers on the road to economic independence. The evening includes welcome bubbles, a three-course dinner, a casino experience, a live auction, the signature Balloon Pop and a runway show with local boutiques and designers. Tickets are $295.

events.name: Frankenstuffies Workshop
events.description: Bring your old stuffed animals to the downtown library, take them apart and stitch them back together as new creatures ready for Halloween. Supplies are also available on site. Free and family-friendly.

events.name: Guided Tours at the Bennett Heritage House
events.description: A guided tour of the Bennett Heritage House, a 1914 Kelowna mansion, with a look at the home's history and the stories behind it. Admission is $20, or $15 for members.

events.name: Horse Drawn Halloween
events.description: Climb aboard a horse-drawn wagon at Caravan Farm Theatre and ride out to the mysterious house in Hullcar Hollow, where ghostly, witchy and wolfish characters await — and brave riders can win a handful of candy. It's a gentle Halloween outing aimed at little ones and the adults with them, with several showings each day. Tickets are $18.90–29.40.

events.name: Spooky Cinema Series Featuring: Sleepy Hollow
events.description: Grizzli Winery's Spooky Cinema Series continues with a Halloween movie night screening of Sleepy Hollow at the West Kelowna winery. Tickets are $10–15.
flags: Tourism Kelowna listing now returns 404; winery calendar still lists it (film at 7 pm)

events.name: Street Fest 2026
events.description: A beverage festival at Rustic Reel Brewing with beer, wine, cider, spirits, sodas and coffee to sample, plus carnival games, cozy lounge spaces, firepits, food from Rustic Reel and a full artisan market. Early bird tickets are $35 and general admission is $39.

events.name: Afternoon Tea at the Bennett House
events.description: A traditional afternoon tea in the main dining and living room of the Bennett Heritage House, with homemade scones, clotted cream and jam, finger sandwiches and desserts, served with tea from the house menu. Tickets are $75.

events.name: Cheese and Charcuterie 101 - Master Class
events.description: A hands-on class led by a cheesemonger at Grate Cheesery. Learn how to shop for, choose, cut, store and pair cheese, then sip a glass of wine while you build your own medium board — enough for four — to take home. Tickets are $125.

events.name: Gin Morgan Live
events.description: A relaxed Sunday-afternoon set from Gin Morgan in the Sandhill Wines lounge, with shareable plates and Sandhill wines available. Admission is free and no reservation is needed.

events.name: Vintage Fashion Show
events.description: A vintage fashion show at Sandhill Wines with two runway presentations of looks from decades past, plus a curated vendor market of fashion, accessories and treasures. Tickets ($45–55) include a glass of wine; minors are welcome with a ticket and get a non-alcoholic drink. All ages; space is limited.

events.name: Paul Cauthen: With Special Guest Leon Majcen
events.description: East Texas country provocateur Paul Cauthen brings his booming "Big Velvet" baritone and a mix of classic-country grit, gospel power and rhinestoned rock-and-roll, touring behind his fifth album, Book of Paul. Leon Majcen opens. Tickets range from about $50 to $233.

events.name: Young Professional Coffee Social
events.description: A casual morning coffee social for young and established professionals, hosted in collaboration with the District of Lake Country at Peaks to Shore in Oyama. Expect networking, coffee and snacks in a friendly setting. Free.

events.name: Danny Bhoy Live
events.description: Scottish comedian Danny Bhoy returns on his ninth cross-Canada tour with Dear World…, a stand-up and theatre hybrid that follows his hit Dear Epson…. Expect sharp observational humour and storytelling, fresh from a sold-out Edinburgh Fringe run. Tickets are about $68–79.

events.name: Christmas Gnome Crafting
events.description: A cozy crafting session at Gray Monk where you design your own custom gnome. Decorate it to suit your home décor year-round or add festive touches for the holidays. Tickets are $62.

events.name: Gaslight
events.description: A stage thriller in a hit Canadian adaptation first seen at the Shaw Festival. Bella Manningham thinks she's losing her mind: every night there are strange sounds and the gas lights dim for no reason. Is she losing her grip on reality, or is someone loosening it for her? Tickets are $48.71, or $42.96 for students and seniors.

events.name: Stage Fright: Musical Theatre Cabaret
events.description: New Vintage Theatre artists perform Hallowe'en favourites and chilling new scenes at this musical theatre cabaret fundraiser. Every guest gets a mystery box and a fortune telling with entry. Costumes welcome; buy tickets early. Proceeds support the company's theatre school and its 15th anniversary season. Tickets are $44, or $38.50 for seniors and students.

events.name: Feminist Horror Festival Public Talks
events.description: A free public evening at UBC Okanagan with horror drag performance artist SKYNSUIT from Providence, Rhode Island, hosted by Michael V. Smith. Expect a romp through mythology, post-humanism and genuine pathos.

events.name: Kelowna Chiefs vs Creston Valley Thunder Cats
events.description: Catch an action-packed night of hockey at Rutland Arena as the home-town Kelowna Chiefs take on the visiting Creston Valley Thunder Cats. Tickets are $6–10.

events.name: Okanagan Sax Live
events.description: An early-evening set from Okanagan Sax in the Sandhill Wines lounge, moving from soulful ballads to energetic jazz improvisation. Admission is free.

events.name: The Insoles & Advil Tour
events.description: CodeBreaker, Dusty Pines and We Are Not A Cult bring the Insoles & Advil Tour to DunnEnzies Downtown for a night of live band music. Entry is $20 or pay what you can — nobody turned away.

events.name: Vancouver International Mountain Film Festival (VIMFF)
events.description: The Vancouver International Mountain Film Festival tour returns to Kelowna with a handpicked selection of the year's best mountain films — adventure, storytelling and big-screen mountain scenery. Tickets are $40.

events.name: HorrorFest XVII
events.description: HorrorFest returns to the Metro Hub for its 17th edition, a night devoted to horror. Admission had not been announced at the time of listing.
flags: Tourism Kelowna listing now returns 404 — could not verify; admission TBA

events.name: Josh Jauncey Kickboxing Seminar
events.description: GLORY Kickboxing veteran Josh Jauncey, once ranked #1 by GLORY and one of Canada's most accomplished active kickboxers, leads a special training seminar at Top Notch Muay Thai. A chance to learn from a fighter with 26 pro and 20 amateur bouts. Tickets are $100.

events.name: Kelowna Chiefs vs Oliver Outlaws
events.description: Catch an action-packed night of hockey at Rutland Arena as the home-town Kelowna Chiefs take on the visiting Oliver Outlaws. Tickets are $8–10.

events.name: Okanagan Vintage Fair
events.description: Billed as the oldest vintage market in the area, this fair fills Parkinson Rec Centre with more than 40 tables of collectibles, antiques, clothing, décor, small furniture, art, comics, toys, vinyl, coins, jewellery and ephemera, with vintage tunes playing as you shop. Admission is $3, and kids 12 and under get in free.

events.name: Retro Halloween Social
events.description: Ex Nihilo's third annual Retro Halloween Social starts with a wander through Halloween tasting stations, each with a throwback trick, a treat and a pour of wine. Then head to the courtyard for live music by Colin Calnan and a cash bar. Costume contest with prizes for best solo, couple and group. Tickets are $30.

events.name: Turkish Mosaic Lamp Workshop
events.description: Magical Mosaics leads a creative afternoon at Gray Monk overlooking the vineyards and Okanagan Lake. Choose your lamp style and build a colourful Turkish mosaic design with guided instruction. Tickets are $120–150.

events.name: UBC Okanagan Engineering Open House
events.description: Prospective students can explore UBC Okanagan Engineering through presentations, booths and campus and lab tours, chatting with professors, students and advisors about programs, student life, co-op and undergraduate research. Free; registering gets you reminders, the schedule and parking details.

events.name: Chris Murphy of SLOAN + Peter Elkas
events.description: Chris Murphy of Sloan — also of supergroups TUNS, Trans-Canada Highwaymen and Anyway Gang — plays a solo acoustic set of songs and stories at Hello Darlin', joined on the bill by Peter Elkas. Tickets are $59.

events.name: Begonia
events.description: Begonia brings a voice that moves from intimate storytelling to soaring, powerhouse moments to Revelry Food and Music Hub. Expect dynamic grooves, heartfelt lyrics, surprises between songs and a crowd that ends up singing along, in a room that keeps you close to the stage. Admission is listed at $44–$80 USD; buy tickets ahead.

events.name: Kelowna Chiefs vs Chase Heat
events.description: Catch an action-packed night of hockey at Rutland Arena as the home-town Kelowna Chiefs take on the visiting Chase Heat. Tickets are $8–10.

events.name: God is a Scottish Drag Queen Halloween Spooktacular
events.description: The deity in the floral power suit returns for a Halloween special at Kelowna Community Theatre. God descends to roast everything from pumpkin spice lattes to demonic possession, with commentary on odd Halloween traditions, terrifying costume choices and the true horror of candy corn. Expect sass, satire and supernatural wit. Admission is $54.11.

events.name: Buena Vista Orchestra
events.description: Cuban music fills Kelowna Community Theatre with the Buena Vista Orchestra, a repertory ensemble featuring a revolving lineup of musicians from groups such as the Buena Vista Social Club and the AfroCuban All Stars, and from the bands of Celia Cruz, Omara Portuondo and Chucho Valdés. Admission ranges from $50.09 to $107.61.

events.name: Rina Garcia Chua “A Geography of (Un)Natural Hazards” Book Launch
events.description: Inspired Word Café hosts an evening of poetry, prose and music at Hello Darlin' to launch Rina Garcia Chua's new book, A Geography of (Un)Natural Hazards, with local writer Cherie Hanson and a Halloween open mic. Spooky-themed performances and costumes are welcome but not required. Entry is $6–$10.

events.name: Chest Fever Presents The Last Waltz: Party Like It's 1976
events.description: Chest Fever brings the original Last Waltz concert back to life at Revelry, which becomes a 1976-themed Halloween weekend party. The evening opens with a VIP experience and a Thanksgiving-style dinner inspired by the original celebration, followed by the concert. Dress in your best '60s and '70s-inspired outfit and come hungry. VIP and general admission tickets run $44.49–$251.49.

events.name: Ron James: The Noise Between Our Ears Live
events.description: Ron James, billed as Canada's #1 stand-up road warrior, brings his new show The Noise Between Our Ears to Kelowna Community Theatre, making sense of a world of seismic social and political change in the language of laughs. Admission is $92.92.

events.name: 6th Annual Halloweenie: Halloween Day Family Celebration
events.description: A non-scary Halloween afternoon at Grizzli Winery for younger and elementary-aged kids; come in costume, and pets are welcome. Expect a bouncy castle, glitter tattoos, pumpkin decorating, crafts, a scavenger hunt, a dance party and s'mores by the fire pit. Pre-purchased child tickets include a Halloweenie Passport and goody bag (not for walk-ins); adult admission includes a glass of mulled or seasonal wine. Admission is $10.

events.name: Bunnicula - The Musical
events.description: A colourful family musical at The Balsam School: when a mysterious bunny arrives and the veggies start losing their colour, the household pets take the case. Is Bunnicula a vampire, or just a misunderstood bunny? The show runs about 60 minutes and suits all ages. Tickets are $25 adult, $12.50 child, or $35 for a one-adult, one-child Dynamic Duo.

events.name: Crystal Journey Halloween Concert
events.description: David Hickey of Crystal Journey plays two sets of improvised sound music on Paiste planet gongs, Persian santoors, quartz crystal bowls and harmonica at Kelowna Yoga Hub. Framed around Samhain, the concert invites reflection on transformation, the cycle of life and death, and letting go of fears. Admission is $40.

events.name: Indulgence Tasting Experience - Halloween Edit
events.description: Azhadi Vineyards gives its Indulgence Tasting a Halloween twist: five wines paired with five desserts from the pastry chef, using flavours such as smoked Okanagan cherries, yuzu, blackberry, apple pie, pomegranate and dark chocolate. Afterwards, a guided tour of the Griffin Gallery explores the winery's art, architecture and stories. Tickets are $96.

events.name: Mafia Murder Mystery
events.description: Step into 1929 at Revelry for a Prohibition-era murder mystery: Godfather Donato Brundizzi is throwing a party with illegal booze and questionable gambling, until things take a deadly turn and everyone becomes a suspect. Mingle with mobsters, molls and flappers, follow the clues and solve the case. Flapper dresses, pinstripe suits and fedoras encouraged. Tickets are $94.17.

events.name: 2026 Okanagan Mushroom Festival
events.description: Celebrate all things fungi at the Okanagan Mushroom Festival, with artisans, crafters, growers and mushroom enthusiasts gathered at the Westbank Lions Community Centre. Entry is by donation, with proceeds going to Stars Piggly Wiggly Animal Sanctuary.

events.name: Cat Clyde & Dean Johnson
events.description: Cat Clyde and Dean Johnson are on tour together and share a night of live music at Revelry. Tickets are $46.61 plus taxes and are on sale now.

events.name: "Actually, It Is Rocket Science" Film Showing
events.description: Teton Gravity Research brings the world premiere tour of its newest ski and snowboard film to the Rotary Centre for the Arts, featuring top athletes charging some of the planet's most incredible lines. Tickets are $31.46 for adults (16+), and $19.99 for youth under 16 and students with ID.

events.name: "The Dinner Theatre" Live
events.description: A world-premiere musical about two Broadway veterans reunited at a dinner theatre in Moncton, written by and starring Canadian recording artist Rick Worrall, with Gwen Plitt and Carmen Harris. Directed by Angela Quinn with music direction by Neville Bowman, it features an original score of ballads and showstoppers. Despite the title, no dinner is served. Tickets are $44, and a matinee is also offered.

events.name: Ballet Kelowna: Four Voices
events.description: Ballet Kelowna opens its season with a mixed program of four works: Simone Orlando's Acts of Remembrance, honouring Canadians who served in the First World War; Trey McIntyre's high-energy The Reassuring Effects (of Form and Poetry), set to Dvořák; and world premieres by company artists Joanna Lige and Donaldo Nava. A pre-show chat with the artistic director is open to all ticket holders. Tickets are $40.81–$102.65, with 150 pay-what-you-wish seats per show.

events.name: Blues Night with Sherman Doucette Harp & Soul
events.description: Sherman Doucette Harp & Soul plays an evening of soulful live blues in the Wine Lounge at Sandhill Urban Winery. The $29 ticket includes a welcome drink, and the Shareables menu and full bar are available throughout the show. Arrive when doors open to settle in before the music starts.

events.name: Candlelight: Tribute to Ed Sheeran & Coldplay
events.description: A string quartet plays Ed Sheeran and Coldplay by candlelight at Revelry, including 'Clocks', 'Fix You', 'Viva la Vida', 'Photograph', 'Perfect' and 'Shivers'. The 60-minute tribute opens doors 45 minutes early with no entry once it starts; seating is first come, first served within each zone. Recommended for ages 8+, with under-16s accompanied by an adult. Tickets are $48–$85 plus taxes.

events.name: Candlelight: Tribute to Michael Jackson
events.description: A string quartet performs the music of Michael Jackson by candlelight at Revelry, from 'I Want You Back' and 'Billie Jean' to 'Man in the Mirror', 'Smooth Criminal' and 'Thriller'. The tribute runs 60 minutes; doors open 45 minutes early and there's no entry once it starts. Recommended for ages 8+, with under-16s accompanied by an adult. Tickets are $48–$85 plus taxes.

events.name: Dinner Series - Sri Lanka
events.description: Ex Nihilo's Dinner Series heads to Sri Lanka with a four-course menu of fragrant spices, creamy coconut and layered heat, from a Hot Butter Crab croquette and Sinhala achcharu to Black Pork Curry with coconut milk rice and mallung. Dinner is $118, and with limited availability, booking early is recommended.

events.name: Main Mom Event
events.description: The Main Mom Event is a large community expo at the Coast Capri Hotel, designed to support moms at every stage of motherhood with a mix of fun and educational content. Admission is $7–$10.

events.name: Minecraft Build Challenge
events.description: School-age kids compete in a Minecraft building contest at the library: a theme is revealed at the start, builders get about 90 minutes, and the top creations are judged and awarded prizes. It's free, and participants may bring their own Xbox controllers.

events.name: Winter Warm-Up Market
events.description: Get a head start on holiday shopping at the Rotary Centre for the Arts, where more than 60 vendors sell handcrafted gifts, artisanal goods, festive treats and one-of-a-kind decorations. Admission is by donation.

events.name: “Dreaming of Marginalia”: A Writing Workshop with Dr. Rina Garcia Chua
events.description: Inspired Word Café and the Okanagan Regional Library host a poetry workshop led by local author Dr. Rina Garcia Chua, open to writers of every level in a supportive learning and sharing setting. It's free with no registration needed; spots are first come, first served.

events.name: Jazz Night Out: Cory Weeds Plays the Music of Huey Lewis
events.description: Saxophonist, record producer and Cellar Music founder Cory Weeds, one of Canada's most active jazz artists, brings his warm sound to the songs of Huey Lewis at Revelry. Tickets are $94.17.

events.name: James Keelaghan and Jez Lowe in concert
events.description: Two folk songwriters share the stage: Juno winner James Keelaghan, whom Rolling Stone called 'Canada's finest songwriter', and England's Jez Lowe, a writer for the BBC's Radio Ballads and host of Open Country on BBC Radio Four. Longtime touring partners, they play two 45-minute sets, accompanying each other. Tickets are $40.

events.name: Hits for Heritage ft. Chilliwack
events.description: The third annual Hits for Heritage fundraiser for the Central Okanagan Heritage Society features Chilliwack on its Farewell to Friends Tour, the last in the band's 55-year history, with the Ryan Donn Band opening. Sing along to 'Fly at Night', 'My Girl (Gone Gone Gone)' and more. There's also a silent auction and a 50/50 raffle. Tickets are $79.

events.name: November Open Mic ft. Glenna Turnbull and Johnny MacRae
events.description: Inspired Word Café's monthly open mic at Hello Darlin' features local author Glenna Turnbull and spoken word poet Johnny MacRae, plus five open mic spots. Sign-up opens with the doors and there's often a line, so arrive promptly if you want to perform. Entry is a $6–$10 sliding scale.

events.name: Kelowna Chiefs vs 100 Mile House Wranglers
events.description: Junior hockey at Rutland Arena, as the Kelowna Chiefs host the 100 Mile House Wranglers in a back-to-back series, so you can catch one game or both. Tickets are $8–$10.

events.name: Surf Hat Fall Tour
events.description: Squamish band Surf Hat plays its cold-water take on surf rock: catchy, relatable beach songs written between the ocean and the mountains, with echoes of Allah-Las, The Growlers and Talking Heads. Tickets are $34.

events.name: A Rocky Mountain High Christmas
events.description: Rick Worrall and his brother Steve lead this John Denver-inspired holiday matinee with guests Delphine Litke, Chad Abrahamson and the Glen Rosa Middle School Choir, backed by an all-star band and symphony ensemble. Rather than impersonating Denver, it honours his spirit through song and storytelling, with orchestrations by his long-time conductor Lee Holdridge. Tickets are $59.50–$79.50.

events.name: Immaculata Annual Christmas Craft Fair
events.description: Immaculata High School's annual Christmas craft fair brings together vendors and artisans, plus a bake sale, children's activities, refreshments and door prizes. Admission is free.

events.name: OC Women's & Men's Basketball Game
events.description: Cheer on the OC Coyotes as their women's and men's basketball teams take on Columbia Bible College in an afternoon of games, in a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere. Admission is $6 for adults, $4 for seniors, and free for children and OC students.

events.name: A Musical Grand Tour
events.description: Early music specialist Ivars Taurins, long associated with Tafelmusik, conducts the Okanagan Symphony Orchestra on a musical grand tour of 18th-century Europe, travelling through Germany, England, Italy and France via the great Baroque masters. Tickets are $18–$75.

events.name: Kelowna Chiefs vs Enderby Icemen
events.description: Junior hockey at Rutland Arena as the Kelowna Chiefs take on the Enderby Icemen. Tickets are $8–$10, making it an easy, affordable night of live hockey.

events.name: Minecraft Escape Room: Deep Sea Dive
events.description: Kids aged 8–12 tackle a Minecraft escape room: stranded on a mysterious island, they solve puzzles, explore mazes, go fishing and even slurp soup to escape. Basic computer skills are needed, and players who want a controller must bring their own wired Xbox controller. Free.

events.name: Okanagan Fight Night 8
events.description: Billed as the Okanagan's premier combat sports event, Okanagan Fight Night returns to Kelowna Community Theatre for its eighth edition, with live bouts from the first walkout to the final bell. The fight card hadn't been announced when the event was listed. Admission is $77.11.

events.name: Proper Man
events.description: Proper Man returns to the Crown & Thieves speakeasy with brand-new material and a packed room in true roaring '20s fashion. events.name: Reggae Glow Fest
events.description: Celebrate Caribbean culture at Metro Hub with T>G & JByrd, playing their first live show with The Keystone Band, plus DJ Shado spinning reggae, dancehall and afrobeats. Caribbean-inspired drinks and the Reggae Fusion Food Truck are on site; bright Caribbean attire encouraged. It's 19+ with photo ID; general admission is $45.

events.name: Delta Grand Holiday Market
events.description: About 100 vendors fill the Delta Hotels Grand Okanagan Resort for a day of festive shopping: handcrafted gifts, artisanal treats and unique holiday decor in a lakeside setting. Admission is by donation.

events.name: A Celtic Family Christmas Party
events.description: Natalie MacMaster and Donnell Leahy, joined by their growing family and world-class band, throw a lively Celtic Christmas party with new versions of classic holiday favourites. Tickets are $70.21.

events.name: The Great Canadian Last Waltz
events.description: Marking the 50th anniversary of The Last Waltz, this show celebrates the music of The Band and their legendary final concert while shining a spotlight on Canadian-made original songs. Admission is $68.77.

events.name: Anne of Green Gables
events.description: New Vintage Theatre's annual holiday play brings the Canadian classic Anne of Green Gables to the stage, the story of a red-headed orphan longing for a home, with a cast of local talent in an all-ages production. Tickets are $42.96 adult, $37.21 student/senior and $31.46 child.

events.name: Holiday Magic Market
events.description: Around 60 local makers take over the Rotary Centre for the Arts with unique, locally handmade items, a one-stop shop for holiday gifts. Admission is by donation.

events.name: PRISM - Canadian Rock Legends Live
events.description: Walk of Fame inductees Prism, the Canadian rock band whose 'Spaceship Superstar' NASA chose as the official song aboard Space Shuttle Discovery's final flight, play Kelowna Community Theatre. Tickets are $69.95–$95.95.

events.name: Handel's Messiah Live
events.description: The Okanagan Festival Singers close their 40th-anniversary season with Handel's Messiah, performing the complete work at this matinee with four guest soloists and a 17-piece orchestra at Evangel Church. Admission is $45. A second, sing-along performance follows later in the season at St. Michael's Cathedral.

events.name: St. Andrews Day
events.description: A celebration of all things Scottish for St. Andrew's Day at the Kelowna Beer Institute. Admission is free, and the party runs from mid-afternoon well into the evening, so drop in whenever it suits you.

events.name: Le Hockey Sweater
events.description: Caravan Farm Theatre's winter show is a joyful, raucous take on Roch Carrier's Canadian classic The Hockey Sweater — a celebration of all things Québécois that brings an outdoor hockey game to the farm's fields and forests. Devised and directed by Manon Beaudoin, with several performances daily and an extra early show on Sundays. Tickets are $57.75–$73.50.

events.name: DIY Postcards Class
events.description: Calling all lovers of snail mail: design your own postcard at the library, draw and colour it, then write a message to a friend or loved one. Blank postcards are supplied and postage stamps are provided for finished cards, so you can send yours on its way. Free.

events.name: Craft Culture Holiday Market
events.description: Kelowna's largest holiday market fills Prospera Place with more than 200 local crafters and artisans selling handcrafted goods and unique creations — a one-stop spot to finish your holiday shopping while supporting local makers. The market runs all weekend, and admission is $7.

events.name: Mountains on Stage Screening
events.description: An evening of films from Mountains on Stage, an international mountain film festival showcasing adventure, climbing, skiing, mountaineering and outdoor films with striking cinematography, screened at the Rotary Centre for the Arts. Tickets are $23–$28.

events.name: Kelly Taylor Live
events.description: Stand-up comedian Kelly Taylor, who was headlining clubs just nine months after first stepping on stage, brings a live comedy set to the Rotary Centre for the Arts. Tickets are $65.

events.name: Handel's Messiah Live
events.description: The Okanagan Festival Singers close their 40th-anniversary season with Handel's Messiah, and this evening performance at St. Michael's Cathedral is a sing-along: audience members are invited to become part of the music. Admission is $15.

events.name: Kelowna Chiefs vs Spokane Braves
events.description: Catch the Kelowna Chiefs taking on the Spokane Braves in a fast, action-packed game of hockey at Rutland Arena. Tickets are $8–$10, making it an easy, affordable night out for hockey fans.

events.name: Freya & Friends Live
events.description: Folk duo Freya returns for a holiday concert with the Okanagan Symphony Chorus, this time welcoming Okanagan jazz vocalist Leila Naderi to mix new songs with reimagined favourites. Tickets range from $18 to $75.

events.name: Holiday Paint & Sip: Christmas Tree Charcuterie Board
events.description: Start in Sandhill's Wine Lounge with a complimentary welcome drink and your own charcuterie board, then settle in for a relaxed, step-by-step painting class, turning a wooden charcuterie board into a festive Christmas tree design to take home. No painting experience needed and all supplies are included. Tickets are $75.

events.name: Xmas Fusion DJ Night
events.description: Mehfil Nights & Beats hosts a multicultural Christmas night out at Revelry, with four-plus DJs mixing Afro beats, Latin, house, rock, Indigenous, hip-hop, R&B, Punjabi, Bollywood and top hits. Expect a selfie-station contest, coat check and food by Quiznos. Dress code: red, white or an ugly Christmas sweater. Tickets are $15–$70.

events.name: Polar Bear Dip

events.name: The Princess Proms Concert
events.description: A live family concert packed with princess songs children know and love, with plenty of chances to sing along — an outing made for little princess fans and their grown-ups. Tickets start at $44.

events.name: New Year Reset: Salt Cave Yin, Sound Healing & Intention Setting
events.description: Aleena McKinnon of Buddha Beats Yoga leads a slow Yin practice in Room and Pillar's Himalayan salt cave, with long-held, supportive shapes for the hips, spine and shoulders, live crystal bowl sound healing, and a closing guided intention-setting meditation to start the year with clarity. $55.

events.name: Come From Away
events.description: The Tony Award-winning musical tells the true story of Gander, Newfoundland, a town of 9,000 that took in nearly 7,000 stranded passengers when 38 planes were ordered to land there on September 11, 2001. Expect a Celtic-infused score and a cast playing multiple roles. Evening shows Wednesday to Saturday plus weekend matinees; tickets $93–$100.

events.name: Chris Lee Plays Marsalis
events.description: The Okanagan Symphony Orchestra features Chris Lee, principal tubist of the National Arts Centre Orchestra, in Wynton Marsalis's genre-blending Concerto for Tuba — a rare chance to hear the tuba as a solo instrument — paired with Dvořák's folk-infused Symphony No. 8. Tickets are $23–$88.

events.name: Ballet Kelowna: A Streetcar Named Desire
events.description: Ballet Kelowna presents John Alleyne's A Streetcar Named Desire, a full-length ballet that reimagines Tennessee Williams' iconic play, rich with drama and passion and set to an original jazz score by Tobin Stokes. Tickets range from $41.94 to $105.61.

events.name: Valentine’s Day Bliss: Yoga, Sound & Local Chocolate in the Salt Cave
events.description: A Valentine's Yin yoga class in Room and Pillar's Himalayan salt cave with Aleena McKinnon of Buddha Beats Yoga: aromatherapy, heart-opening postures, a long savasana with hands-on assists and the sounds of a crown chakra bowl and chimes, finished with locally handcrafted chocolate from Karat. Come on your own or bring someone you love. $55.

events.name: Chopin & Beethoven
events.description: Twelve-year-old pianist Angela Yixuan Miao plays Chopin's Piano Concerto No. 2, with conductor Monica Chen leading a program of resilience and contrast: Beethoven's dramatic Coriolan Overture and buoyant Eighth Symphony, plus Canadian composer Stephen Chatman's Over Thorns to Stars. Tickets are $23–$88.

events.name: Spring Awakening: Easter Yin Yoga, Sound Healing & Renewal in the Salt Cave!
events.description: An Easter evening in Room and Pillar's Himalayan salt cave with Aleena McKinnon of Buddha Beats Yoga: a gentle spring-inspired Yin practice for the hips, spine and shoulders, live crystal singing bowls, and a closing spring renewal meditation for setting intentions. $60.

events.name: The Four Seasons Re-Composed
events.description: Violinist Kerson Leong joins music director Julian Pellicano and the Okanagan Symphony Orchestra for Max Richter's The Four Seasons Re-Composed, a minimalist reimagining of Vivaldi, while the Okanagan Symphony Chorus sings great Handel choruses among Baroque instrumental works. Tickets are $23–$88.

events.name: Chicago The Musical

Expect a Bob Fosse-style score with “All That Jazz”, “Cell Block Tango” and “Razzle Dazzle”. Tickets are $93–$100.

events.name: Manifest in the Cave: Yoga, Visualization & Intention Setting
events.description: Aleena McKinnon of Buddha Beats Yoga leads an evening in Room and Pillar's Himalayan salt cave: a gentle, grounding yoga practice, a guided visualization journey to connect with your future self, and reflective journaling to put your intentions into writing. $55.

events.name: Okanagan Symphony Season Finale
events.description: The Okanagan Symphony Orchestra closes its season with the BC premiere of Jean Coulthard's long-overlooked Symphony No. 1, presented in partnership with the National Arts Centre Orchestra and paired with Brahms' Symphony No. 1, conducted by music director Julian Pellicano. Tickets are $23–$88.

events.name: Ballet Kelowna: Double Take

events.name: Avenue Q
